script: f(){ sleep 5; }; f & p=$!; kill "$p"; wait "$p"; echo "status=$?"
f(){ sleep 5; }; f & kill %1; wait %1; echo "status=$?"
f(){ return 5; }; f & p=$!; sleep 0.3; kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; echo "kill=$?"; wait "$p"; echo "status=$?"
f(){ sleep 0.3; }; f & p=$!; kill -0 "$p" && echo alive; wait "$p"; kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo gone
